Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: George Osborne today refused to match Labour's pledge not to increase VAT as a row erupted over how to balance the books after the election. The Chancellor declined to give a 'cast-iron guarantee' to match Labour's pledge not to increase VAT over the five years of the next Parliament. It came after Labour's shadow chancellor Ed Balls that Conservatives had a history of raising VAT after elections despite saying they had no plans to do so during the campaign. Scroll down for video Chancellor George Osborne declined to give a 'cast-iron guarantee' to match Labour's pledge not to increase VAT from 20 per cent over the five years of the next Parliament
@highlight
Labour's Ed Balls unveils poster warning Tories will hike VAT again
@highlight
Osborne used first Budget in 2010 to increase rate from 17.5% to 20%
@highlight
Chancellor insists his plans to balance books do not require new increase
@highlight
But he repeatedly refused to match Labour's promise ahead of election
Query: Mr Balls claimed the @placeholder 'have a secret plan to raise VAT again'

Options : A. George Osborne
B. Budget
C. Ed Balls
D. Tories
E. Parliament
F. Osborne
G. Labour

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
